saw_lines: People pick a functional drink by flavor, then reorder only when the calm shows up on a regular schedule.
So the sale is won on the first screen, where the offer either appears or gets scrolled past.
Your site offers a first order discount, but only 1 of 19 ads mention it. Put it in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 31 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers a first order discount, yet only 1 of 19 ads mention it. A new buyer sees no reason to act today. Put the first order offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

Your site runs a subscribe and save offer, yet 0 of 30 live ads mention a subscription. Repeat buyers never hear that it saves them money on every shipment. Run two retention ads with the subscription saving as the headline.
The offer appears after 95% of the copy on a median ad of 66 words, so most viewers stop before reaching it. Move the first order offer into the first two lines of every ad and keep the body short.

7 of 19 copy ads open on the same “drink that turned heads” line, while the other 12 spread across seven other openings. Test two new angles against that opener, one on flavor and one on next-day headaches.

ads_1: First order offer up front, tested against the flavor and next-day headache angles
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Tiktok, Twitter and Youtube
